basis: Eight closed 526-taxon candidate species-tree ML/consensus views, all 125 independently audited gene trees per profile/MAFFT alignment. Sixteen native IQ-TREE gCF jobs, 8,368 branch summaries and 1,046,000 branch-marker cells. Independent DendroPy bipartition reconstruction checks every cell, incident-clade taxon coverage, a consistent NNI mapping, counts, percentages, native branch IDs/tree labels and branch lengths. Full input census passed 1,037 bindings before plan creation. Synthetic native six-taxon all-state and zero-decisive checks passed; 19 false exports rejected. Native software fixture is not a biological pilot or a calibrated full-dataset runtime. Two CPU/16 GiB/no swap/one BLAS thread per serial producer/reader/closure, no GPU, new charges or changes to existing jobs.
